_rationale: Year 0: primary is 70 (selfRmd=0), spouse is 73 (spouseRmd=200000/26.5=7547.17). Only the spouse account triggers an RMD — proves the per-owner split is working. Year 3: primary reaches 73 so both fire: selfRmd=300000/26.5=11320.75 plus spouseRmd from the now-smaller spouse balance (≈7484) for a combined ≈18805. MFJ standard deduction absorbs the small RMD each year so no tax, and 0% return means the total portfolio stays at $500k throughout (money just moves from Traditional to auto-created Taxable).
